title: Plan Sync labels + DB3 import that actually lands in PSR
description:
Plan Sync list labels showed weird characters (quote + cent) between client, city, and jobsite because a bad character-repair pass corrupted the separator in the UI code. Those separators are restored to a normal middle-dot.

DB3 Commit could toast success even when zero pipes were added. Cross-jobsite “same reference elsewhere” warnings were treated like hard duplicates and defaulted to Exclude, so a whole preview could be skipped while still saying success. Commit now reports how many segments were added, errors clearly when nothing imported, imports cross-jobsite warnings by default, and still excludes true same-jobsite duplicates unless you choose Include.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan Sync + DB3 importer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh. Plan Sync names should read Client · City · Jobsite. Re-preview/commit the DB3 — toast should say how many segments imported (or explain why none did).
changeLog: Restore Plan Sync / importer client·city·jobsite separators (remove "¢ garbage).
DB3 commit returns added/skipped counts and fails clearly when nothing imported.
Cross-jobsite placed-duplicate warnings default to Include; same-jobsite duplicates still default Exclude.
Toast shows where segments landed (including Import Sort when no client was set).
createPlannerRecord on DB3 commit now passes the request for correct tenancy/scopes.
